description: Catalog-backed company universe for top-down market research. Catalog roster selection is the default runtime path; procedural company generation remains available as an explicit fallback.

field_notes.subsector: More granular business grouping for top-down filters and story targeting.
field_notes.commodity_exposures: Signed sensitivity where positive benefits from higher commodity prices and negative is input-cost pressure.
field_notes.macro_exposures: Signed sensitivity to macro drivers where positive benefits from stronger driver values.
field_notes.price_traits: Normalized hints for future price-engine integration; values are advisory until wired by later tasks.
field_notes.relationship_hooks: Potential graph edges for future supplier/customer/partner/competitor/acquirer logic.
field_notes.story_hooks: Machine-readable story seeds for future dossier, news, Twooter, Network, filing, and thesis systems.
